HomeNote Terms of Service

Effective date: [○ ○, 2026]

This English version is a translation provided for convenience. If there is any conflict or inconsistency between the Korean and English versions, the Korean version prevails.

Article 1 (Purpose)

These Terms set out the conditions and procedures for using the HomeNote app and related services (the "Service") provided by [Darak Studio](the "Company"), and the rights and obligations of the Company and users.

Article 2 (Definitions)

  • User: a person who agrees to these Terms and uses the Service
  • Family: a group within the Service that a user has created or joined by invitation
  • Admin: the person who created the family or a member given admin rights. Admins can invite and remove members and configure features (modules)
  • Managed profile: a profile for a child under 14 in which the guardian registers only a name and date of birth. It has no account or sign-in
  • Free trial: the period of 7 days from when a family is created during which all features can be used for free
  • Full access pass: a paid product that, once purchased, lets the entire family keep using all features of the Service

Article 3 (Effect and amendment of the Terms)

  1. These Terms are posted in the app or on the website, and a user is deemed to have agreed to them upon signing in.
  2. The Company may amend these Terms to the extent that doing so does not violate applicable laws. When amending them, the Company will give notice from 7 days before they take effect (30 days before for changes unfavorable to users).
  3. If you do not agree to the amended Terms, you may stop using the Service and delete your account.

Article 4 (Sign-up and accounts)

  1. Users sign up by signing in with an Apple, Google or Kakao account.
  2. Persons under 14 cannot sign up themselves. A guardian may register a child as a managed profile.
  3. Users must manage their own sign-in method and may not transfer or lend it to anyone else.

Article 5 (Families and sharing)

  1. Members of the same family can see each other's shared family records, such as tracked items, lists and events.
  2. Take care that invitation links and codes are used only by the people who received them. An invitation code can be used only once within 7 days.
  3. Admins can remove members or change their roles. If the last admin of a family deletes their account, the family and all of its records are deleted.

Article 6 (Content of the Service)

  1. The Company provides home and car maintenance interval tracking, document expiry tracking, shared lists, a family calendar, to-dos, anniversary and family occasion records, fixed expense payment dates, child care, allowance records, a trip planner (including photos), family notes and quick alerts, weather, a family dashboard, and due date notifications.
    • The allowance feature is for record-keeping only. It does not send or hold actual money and is not a financial service.
  2. When you create a family, you can try all features free for 7 days. After the trial ends, you must purchase the full access pass to keep using the Service. Until you purchase it, you can only view or delete records you registered and delete your account, and no notifications are sent. You will not be charged automatically when the trial ends.
  3. A family can register up to 6 members (including managed profiles).
  4. Notifications are an aid to help you keep track of schedules. Notifications may be delayed or not delivered because of device settings, network conditions, operating system policies and the like, so users must check legal deadlines themselves (e.g., periodic vehicle inspections, insurance renewals).

Article 7 (Full access pass)

  1. The full access pass is purchased through in-app purchase on the Apple App Store or Google Play, and payment and receipts are handled by each app store.
  2. Once purchased, it applies to the entire family the purchaser belongs to, giving access to all features offered now and all features added in the future (up to 6 members; no limit on the number of tracked items or lists).
  3. The full access pass can be used with no time limit, meaning for as long as the Company provides the Service. If the Service is to be discontinued, the Company will give advance notice in accordance with Article 10.
  4. Refunds follow each app store's refund policy and procedures. Rights of cancellation under applicable laws, such as when a minor pays without the consent of a legal guardian, are guaranteed.
  5. If a purchase is not reflected in the app, you can tap "Restore purchase" on the payment screen or contact support.

Article 8 (Users' obligations)

Users must not do any of the following.

  • Wrongfully using another person's account or invitation code
  • Circumventing or interfering with the Service's security, payment or usage restrictions
  • Reverse engineering the Service or sending excessive requests by automated means
  • Registering content that violates laws or public order

Article 9 (Posts and data)

  1. Rights to the records a user registers belong to the user. The Company stores and processes them only to the extent necessary to provide the Service.
  2. Even if you delete your account, records the family used together remain for the other members; only the author information is deleted.
  3. Personal information is processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy.

Article 10 (Changes to and suspension of the Service)

  1. The Company may change the Service as needed for operational or technical reasons, and will give advance notice of important changes.
  2. The Service may be temporarily suspended because of equipment maintenance, failures, natural disasters and the like.
  3. If the Service is to be discontinued, the Company will notify users in the app or on the website at least 30 days before the end date and allow a period during which users can review their records.

Article 11 (Usage restrictions and account deletion)

  1. Users can withdraw at any time from All tab > Delete account in the app (Simple mode: Home ⚙️ > Delete account).
  2. The Company may restrict the use of a user who violates Article 8, and in that case will notify the user of the reason.

Article 12 (Limitation of liability)

  1. Unless it acts intentionally or with gross negligence, the Company is not liable for damages caused by missed notifications or by errors in information entered by users.
  2. The Company has no obligation to intervene in disputes between users (between family members).

Article 13 (Governing law and disputes)

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea, and any dispute shall be submitted to [the competent court under the Civil Procedure Act].
